items.name: Anand Rathi Wealth Limited
items.title: Anand Rathi Wealth Limited hereby inform you that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled to be held on Thursday, 09th July, 2026 to, inter-alia:i. Consider, approve and take on record the Unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results of the Company for the First Quarter ended 30th June, 2026 after these results are reviewed by the Audit Committee of the Board.ii. Any Other matter with permission of the chair.

items.name: Tata Consultancy Services Limited
items.title: TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Board Meeting to be held on 09-Jul-2026 to consider and approve the Quarterly Audited Financial results of the Company for the period ended June 2026 and Dividend.
